data.name: DFDC The Hague
data.notes: Data Facilities Data Centers (DFDC) operates THG1 in The Hague, a carrier-neutral data center built by operators, for operators. THG1 sits between the Amsterdam and Rotterdam metros with fault-tolerant, path-diverse fiber to both, making it a second regeneration point on the north–south corridor rather than a spur off one. 25 networks are present in the building and the number keeps growing, with 10/100/400G wavelengths to major Amsterdam and Rotterdam facilities. BareFABRIC, our own metro fabric across ten Dutch locations, adds native peering and L2 EVPN transport on every port. The site is concurrently maintainable — separate chilled-water loops, three ATS-separated electrical paths, three generator-backed UPS clusters each N+1 at module level — designed for 3.5 MW gross with up to 20 kW per air-cooled cabinet. ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certified, 99.99% uptime SLA. Phase I is largely sold; Phase II is in final planning.
